APPROVE

The bracket-location logic moves unchanged into `TryFindArrayLiteral`, with the same checks in the same order and `open`/`close` passed back as out parameters. That drops several branches from `LiteralStringArrayArgument`, which brings it well under 15 and leaves the all-or-nothing behaviour intact. I only saw the diff hunk, not the rest of the method. The approval assumes nothing after the hunk reads the removed locals `at` or `after`; the diff's comment suggests `after` is only used for the operator check.
